stemMd: What is the least positive period of y=cos(3x), with x measured in radians?
explanationMd: The argument must increase by 2π for a full cycle. Thus 3T=2π and T=2π/3. Multiplying input compresses the horizontal period.

distractorRationale.e: This multiplies instead of dividing the usual period.
distractorRationale.a: This ignores the factor 3 in the argument.
distractorRationale.b: This is only half a full cosine period.
distractorRationale.d: This scales in the wrong direction.
